How it works onchain

Solana devnet
01

Verifiable pack draws

MagicBlock VRF decides the rarity and writes it to your player account onchain, so the odds can't be quietly edited.

02

Fast trading sessions

Runs are delegated to an Ephemeral Rollup, where score updates confirm instantly, then committed back to base and settled exactly once.

03

Private positions

Your position size stays hidden during a run. The board reveals final results, not your live strategy.
